Notes
NOTE: paladin and ranger versions have a higher effect because a paladin or ranger would need to be 8th level, with a caster level of 4, to cast an 2nd level spell. The higher DC comes from the requirement that a paladin or ranger would need to have a wisdom of at least 14 (+2 modifier) to know a 2nd level spell.
